basis: The legacy network cannot distinguish some source-dependent target decisions (D-095). Test whether predicting entity retention and simulating alternative stat effects can improve resource allocation in natural games.
learning: 512 independent natural v14 games, two interleaved 256-game training splits. Use public own board at EOT T7-12 and whether that exact entity is still in play two EOTs later, conditional on reaching that turn. No outcome-selected games or card ID input. Standardized ridge 150.
intervention: Only when original action targets an own minion at T7-12 with >=2 legal friendly targets. Compare actual native counterfactual effects under two independent reseeds (no original RNG). Preserve board identities, keywords and attachments, equal spending, health, hand and cleared pending selection among the compared actions. Use 0.35 times immediate total stat gain plus predicted retention times permanent stat gains. Both estimated margins must exceed max(2,20% of stat change). Heuristic teacher with search, not a standalone production model.
test: 256 common new v14hold natural game seeds 88300000..88300255, both frozen retention heads plus parent. Evaluate original terminal utility, all D-128 thresholds, intervention coverage. No large run on proxy alone; if the planner qualifies, test distillation and independently validate the students.
